name: AI Captions
route: (opens from the Add AI Captions button in Avatar, Cinema, Effects, Lip Sync, Video, Video Tools and Template studios)
description: AI Captions adds animated word-by-word captions to a video. Pick any video you made, or upload one, choose a look, fix the words, then download the captioned MP4 or the .srt, .vtt or .txt files.
shortDescription: Caption any video you made, edit the words, and download it with the captions burned in.
fullDescription: AI Captions opens as a window from the '💬 Add AI Captions' button in the studios. It has four tabs: Create, Script & Words, Motion & Style and History. On Create, 'Your videos' lists every video you made in the app (newest first, with a first-frame picture, search, and studio filters); the one you opened it from is already picked. You can also upload a video or paste a video link. 'On this device' (default) listens to the audio with Whisper in your browser, so nothing is uploaded; 'AI themes (cloud)' sends the video to the caption service instead and returns a finished video. Pick one of 49 caption looks (the six popular ones are Hormozi, MrBeast, Karaoke, Minimal, Bounce and Classic), see it drawn over a real frame of your video, and move it Top, Middle or Bottom with the slider. Press 'Generate Captions'. Script & Words then shows each line with its time: click a word to fix it, use Find & Replace, change the casing, nudge a line by 0.1 s, split, merge, add or delete lines. 'Apply & Re-render' burns the edited captions into the video in your browser. Download the MP4, or the .srt, .vtt or .txt. History keeps your caption jobs in this browser only.
bestFor: Adding captions to a video you already made without uploading it, then fixing wrong words before posting.
whenToUse: You made a video and want animated captions on it.
You need a subtitle file (.srt or .vtt) or a plain transcript (.txt).
You want to correct spelling in the captions before you post.
whenToUseAnother: Use the Timeline Editor (#/timeline) when you want captions as part of a bigger edit with music and other clips.
Use Template Generator when you want to build a short video from scratch with captions included.
keyFeatures: 'Your videos': every video made in the app, picked for you, no upload needed.
49 caption looks, previewed on a real frame of your video.
Top / Middle / Bottom and a 5 to 90 percent from-the-bottom slider.
Script & Words editor: fix words, find & replace, casing, nudge 0.1 s, split, merge, add, delete.
Captions made on this device with Whisper; clips longer than 3 minutes are done in pieces.
Download the burned-in MP4, or .srt, .vtt and .txt.
History of caption jobs with duration, language, style, position, processing time, size and date.
'AI themes (cloud)' keeps the original 18 cloud caption themes.

featureExplanations.explanation: The Create tab lists the videos made in the app: from your history on this device (and the cloud copy when you are signed in) and any video finished during this visit. Click one to pick it.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: You do not have to upload anything to caption a video you just made.

featureExplanations.explanation: After Generate Captions, each line of speech appears with its time. Click a word to correct it; use Find & Replace for repeated mistakes; AA / Aa / aa change the casing; -0.1s / +0.1s move a line; Split, Merge and the cross edit the lines.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Whisper can mishear names and product words; fix them before you export.

featureExplanations.explanation: Burns the current words, look and position into the video in your browser and gives you 'Download Video (.mp4)'. After an edit the button says 'Apply & Re-render'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Your edits only reach the video when you re-render; the .srt, .vtt and .txt downloads always use the current words.

featureExplanations.explanation: Keeps each job in this browser: title, duration, language, style, position, processing time, file size and date. 'Open & edit' reopens the script (and the video when it was kept).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Come back to fix a word later without listening to the video again.

howToUse: 1. Press '💬 Add AI Captions' in a studio (or open the window from where you made the video). 2. On Create, check the video that is picked under 'Your videos', or choose another, upload one, or paste a link. 3. Choose the language (or Detect) and a caption look; move it with Top / Middle / Bottom. 4. Press 'Generate Captions' and wait; the first run downloads the Whisper model. 5. On Script & Words, correct any words. 6. Press 'Apply & Re-render' if needed, then 'Download Video (.mp4)', or download SRT, VTT or TXT.
howToSteps: Open AI Captions from the Add AI Captions button.
Check or choose the video under 'Your videos'.
Choose language and a caption look, and the position.
Fix any wrong words on Script & Words.
Download the MP4, or SRT, VTT or TXT.
inputs: A video (made in the app, uploaded, or an https link)
optionalInputs: Source: on this device or AI themes (cloud)
outputs: A video with the captions burned in (MP4)
A history entry in this browser
limitations: On this device, Whisper runs in the browser: the first run downloads a model and a long clip takes a while without a graphics card.
Burning the video needs a browser with video encoding (Chrome, Edge or Safari); otherwise only the .srt, .vtt and .txt downloads work.
A video from another website may not be readable by the browser; captions still work but the burned-in MP4 may not.
Videos made in this visit (such as an export) disappear from 'Your videos' when the page is closed.
History is kept in this browser only and keeps the 30 newest jobs; the video is kept only for clips up to 100 MB.
The language shown for Detect is read from the text, not reported by Whisper.
troubleshooting: 'No speech was found to caption': the clip has no clear speech; try another clip or language.
The window says the browser cannot export video: use Chrome, Edge or Safari, or download the .srt/.vtt/.txt.
Generate takes a long time: use a smaller Accuracy option, or the local Whisper.cpp server on your computer.
Your video is missing from the list: it may not have been saved to history; upload it or paste its link.
Words are wrong: click the word on Script & Words and fix it, then press Apply & Re-render.
exampleWorkflows: Generate an avatar video, press 'Add AI Captions', keep the picked video, choose Hormozi, Generate, fix the product name, Re-render and download the MP4.
Open AI Captions, pick last week's video from 'Your videos', Generate, download the .srt and upload it to your video host.
relatedStudioGuidance: Use Avatar or Video Tools to make the video, then add captions here.
Use the Timeline Editor to add captions inside a larger edit.
notConfirmed: Speed on a graphics card was not measured here.
The cloud 'AI themes' route was not run with a real key in this check.

verification.evidence: Read the AI Captions modal and its helpers; ran it in a real browser (on-device transcription, picker, burn-in to MP4).
